title: Gardens of the World Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **The Gardens of the World (Gärten der Welt) are in Marzahn:** 26 minutes on the U5 from Alexanderplatz to Kienberg, inside the normal AB fare zone.
**13 gardens:** Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Balinese, walled Oriental, Renaissance, Christian and Jewish gardens, an English cottage garden, a maze and more. Plan three to four hours.
**The cable car from U Kienberg runs daily 10:00 to 17:00 until 1 November.** From 2 November it stops for its overhaul, then runs at weekends from 5 December.
**Ticket desks close at 18:00 in October and March, 16:00 from November to February, 20:00 from April to September.** The park opens at 09:00, the Japanese Garden at 10:00.
**Adult day ticket EUR 9 until 31 October, EUR 4 from 1 November.** With the cable car: EUR 12.90 in summer, EUR 6.90 in winter.
**In past winters the Japanese and Korean gardens closed** from early November to the end of March. The Balinese tropical hall is indoors and warm all year.
**My move:** go before 1 November and be at the main gate by 14:00, or by 13:00 after the clocks change on 25 October.
